description: Wait for an async extraction job and report its status (queued/running/completed/failed/cancelled). Set wait_seconds to block until the job finishes instead of polling. The result is left out by default, since a full extraction runs to hundreds of kilobytes: hand the job_id to generate_design_md, export_dtcg, get_findings or the other tools, or set include_result for the raw extraction.

include_result.description: Include the raw extraction. Large: prefer passing job_id to another tool

job_id.description: The job_id returned by an extraction tool

wait_seconds.description: Block up to this many seconds for the job to finish; returns as soon as it does

name: get_job_status
